**Pull request #4324 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# PR #4324: Patch: the game log's card buttons meet the 24-pixel target on a mouse too

Closes #4296

## What changed

Each card-naming game-log line now exposes a hit target at least 24 pixels tall on fine pointers (mouse), while the log keeps its dense inline look and touch screens keep their 44-pixel rows. The accessibility statement no longer lists the sub-24-pixel mouse spacing as a known gap. Presentation only — no engine, server, or spec changes.

- [inspectable.css](apps/web/src/game/inspectable.css): new `@media (pointer: fine)` block giving `.log .log-card` `display: inline-block` (so `min-height` takes effect on the otherwise `inline` button) and `min-height: 24px`, placed between the base rule and the untouched coarse-pointer 44px block, with a WCAG 2.5.8 comment.
- [Log.test.tsx](apps/web/src/game/Log.test.tsx): new `describe("the log's card-name target size")` with two stylesheet-text tests — the fine-pointer 24px rule plus retained `display: inline` base, and the verbatim coarse-pointer 44px block — using `readSheet` from `src/test/setup.ts`.
- [accessibility.tsx](apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx), [static-pages.ts](apps/web/static-pages.ts), [zh-CN.json](apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json): the "With a mouse, the card names in the game log…" known-gap bullet removed from all three copies. `board.css`, `Log.tsx`, and `spec/` untouched per the plan.

## How I tested it

- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/Log.test.tsx` — 52/52 pass, including the 2 new tests (re-confirmed via `-t "target"`: 4 matched, 4 passed, 0 failed).
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/static-pages.test.ts` — 24/24 pass, including the word-for-word accessibility quote test proving route and `PAGE_TEXT` match.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/i18n/i18n.test.ts` — 7/7 pass with `--testTimeout=120000`.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — exit 0. `pnpm exec eslint` on the three touched web files — exit 0. `cargo fmt --check` — exit 0.

## Decisions and things a reviewer should look at twice

- No decisions beyond the plan: I followed it exactly and departed nowhere, so there is no rejected alternative to record.
- Two environmental flakes on this shared box, both proven unrelated to the change: the i18n whole-source scan test alone takes 6.1 s and trips vitest's default 5 s timeout (passes with a longer timeout; the removed bullet has zero remaining `t()`/locale references), and `tsc` OOM-crashes under Node's default 2 GB heap (passes cleanly with `--max-old-space-size=6144`). CI's stronger runners should not hit either, but the timeout margin on that i18n scan test is thin everywhere.
- Real-pixel truth stays with the existing CI specs (`38-accessibility.cy.ts` axe run, board-layout pixel budget), untouched as planned; the new unit tests assert stylesheet text because jsdom cannot measure pixels.

### Its own review

Built and checked on `muse`. This is a draft while its own review run, on the same subscription, reviews it adversarially and fixes what it finds (up to 3 rounds); CI runs on it meanwhile. Once that review approves it, it is marked ready and auto-merge turns on.

<details><summary>Rounds and checks</summary>

| Round | Builder | Checks | Review |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | build, 46.5 min | green | - |

| Gate | Result | Time |
|---|---|---|
| rustfmt (`cargo fmt --check`) | pass | 14s |
| catalog (`cargo jackioh catalog check`) | pass | 1052s |
| patches (`cargo jackioh patches check`) | pass | 9s |
| rulings (`cargo jackioh spec check`) | pass | 14s |

</details>

---
Built overnight by @jgoetzmann-bot ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44752936499)); every run on it, step by step, is in its [journal](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/_bot-journal/4296.md). Comment `@jgoetzmann-bot <what to change>` or `/harness revise <notes>` to ask for a revision, or `/harness stop` to stop it.
```

WCAG 2.2 success criterion 2.5.8 (Target Size Minimum, level AA, the level the statement checks at) asks for at least 24 by 24 pixels. Hold it with a stylesheet unit test in the style of the existing CSS tests plus the existing axe/e2e coverage at a desktop size. No engine, server or spec rule changes: this is presentation only. ## Where it lands Files: `apps/web/src/game/inspectable.css` (the `.log .log-card` rule and its coarse-pointer 44-pixel row), `apps/web/src/game/board.css` (the `.log` / `.log-line` list styling), `apps/web/src/game/Log.tsx` (behaviour unchanged; the button it already draws), `apps/web/src/routes/accessibility.tsx` (the known-gaps bullet that documents this gap is removed). SPEC section: §10.10 (client rendering).
